title: Neural Oscillations
content_html:
Neural Oscillations

Theta provides episodic “frames” within which gamma bursts encode items; alpha suppresses distractors; during sleep, slow oscillations coordinate thalamic spindles and hippocampal ripples to consolidate memories.
